preparation.description: Generation-outage outlooks including submitted CROW outages and offered OUTAGE commit status; not measured forced outages.

timing_policy.eligibility: Start of the calendar day after the report date, in America/Chicago.
timing_policy.intervals: Market Hour is the UTC interval end, matching gridstatus's SPP outage reader.
timing_policy.selection: Latest eligible report containing that exact forecast hour; no forward fill or interpolation.
timing_policy.limitation: Retrospective dated snapshots; exact historical publication times and revision availability are unverified.

paired_brier_changes_vs_first_run.method: Paired seven-day block bootstrap; descriptive retrospective proxy comparison.

limitations: High demand is an assumed stress proxy, not an observed emergency or site interruption.
Reanalysis weather is retrospective; historical publication availability is not established.
All models use the identical observed evaluation hours. No fitting or calibration occurs here.
Comparison does not promote a model or validate annual exposure tails.
This candidate did not improve the existing demand proxy; it was not promoted.
The common 2025 evaluation period was already inspected in previous research. This is an exploratory comparison, not a fresh unseen evaluation.
Outage totals and listed fuel components differ in some original documents. All affected predictor values are quarantined rather than repaired.
Next-day eligibility is a conservative date-based assumption; exact historical publication and revision times remain unverified.
Generation-outage outlooks include planned outages and cannot alone establish reserve shortages, forced outages, or emergency events.
